item.title: Cox Vastgoed Acquires 5.2-Hectare Greenhouse Facility in Sevenum
item.description: Cox Vastgoed B.V. will acquire a 5.2-hectare greenhouse facility from paprika grower Frank Bakker in Sevenum on December 1, 2026.

item.title: Anaergia Secures California's First SB 1440 RNG Contract Approval
item.description: CPUC conditionally approved a long-term biomethane procurement contract between Anaergia's SoCal Biomethane, Anew Climate, and Southwest Gas.

item.title: Total Seed Production Acquires Bayer's Windfall Soybean Facility in Indiana
item.description: Total Seed Production acquired Bayer's soybean facility in Windfall, Indiana on March 16th, marking an expansion of its production footprint.

item.title: Agrim Raises $17.3M in Series B Funding Round Led by Asia Impact Fund
item.description: Agrim raised $17.3M in Series B funding led by Asia Impact Fund, with continued support from Kalaari Capital, among other investors.

item.title: The Staple Crop Shift: How Crop Genomics Is Turning to Wheat and Rice
item.description: Explore how investment in crop genomics is shifting to staple crops like wheat and rice, impacting global food security.

item.title: University of Essex Joins £35.4M PhenomUK Plant Research Initiative
item.description: The University of Essex is participating in PhenomUK, a £35.4 million, six-year project funded through the UKRIIF and led by BBSRC.

item.title: Hydrofarm Reports Q4 2025 Financial Results with $232M Impairment Charge
item.description: Hydrofarm's net sales decreased 32.7% to $25.1M in Q4 2025 compared to $37.3M in the prior year period, primarily due to industry oversupply.

item.title: ADAMA Reports Improved Financials in Q4 2025 Results
item.description: ADAMA achieved a 25% increase in adjusted EBITDA to $587 million for full year 2025, with EBITDA margin improving from 11.3% to 14.5%.

item.title: Techwave Partners with Capital Farm Credit to Launch AgriNext Platform Across North America
item.description: Techwave announced a partnership with Capital Farm Credit to serve as the exclusive Go-To-Market partner for AgriNext in North America.

item.title: Agricultural Commodities Market Update (March 23 – 30, 2026)
item.description: Explore the latest trends in agricultural commodities including insights on corn, soybeans, and tea price changes.

item.title: Agriculture Stocks: Market Performance March 23 – 27, 2026
item.description: Explore the latest trends in agriculture stocks and see how FMC Corp and Bayer AG performed this week amid market changes.

item.title: Nature Robots Secures €4 Million Seed Funding to Scale Autonomous Farming Software
item.description: Nature Robots closed a €4M seed financing round led by strategic investors Climentum Capital, Bayern Kapital, and Planetary Impact Ventures.

item.title: NDSU Receives $45M NSF Award for AgTech Engine Expansion
item.description: The National Science Foundation awarded $45M over three years to the North Dakota AgTech Engine housed at North Dakota State University.

item.title: CAAIN Launches $9M Open Competition to Advance Canadian Agri-Food Technology
item.description: CAAIN launched a $9M open competition to foster advances in Canada's agri-food sector, with a maximum of $3M per individual project.

item.title: Bom Group and HX Agriculture Sign Long-Term Greenhouse Partnership in China
item.description: Bom Group and HX Agriculture have signed a long-term cooperation agreement to build multiple HX AGF greenhouses across China.
